This document outlines the equipment inspection I1 on low voltage 
air circuit breaker 380 v 
which must be performed on yearly bases or 1000 operations.

The first draft initiated by eng. Ashraf Kamal Oshba, tested by eng. Reda 
Ragab Karam, accepted by general manager eng. Hamdy Dorgam , approved by eng. 
Gaber Mohamed Farahat and
certified by eng. Sania 
Diab Attia: WDEPC inspection head sector and MPIS coordinator.

items:
A work permit must be 
 issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID 
 safety category.

Safety fence 
 with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear your safety 
 equipment as helmet, shoes, bearthing mask, safety glass... etc

Switch off the CB and 
 withdraw it from its cell.

Switch off the DC power 
 supply for this CB.
Safety and helmet tools as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc.

Clean the 
carbon deposit and metal splashes, especially on the insulating parts.

Remove 
humps on contacts surface by filling.

Examine 
secondary and arcing contacts, and replace them when necessary.

Lubricated all friction 
parts with grease.

Test the breaker 
manually several times.

Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1 on low voltage 
air circuit breaker 380 v 
which must be performed on yearly bases or 1000 operations.
The first draft initiated by eng. Ashraf Kamal Oshba, tested by eng. Reda 
Ragab Karam, accepted by general manager eng. Hamdy Dorgam , approved by eng. 
Gaber Mohamed Farahat and
certified by eng. Sania 
Diab Attia: WDEPC inspection head sector and MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be 
 issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID 
 safety category.
Safety fence 
 with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear your safety 
 equipment as helmet, shoes, bearthing mask, safety glass... etc
Switch off the CB and 
 withdraw it from its cell.
Switch off the DC power 
 supply for this CB.
Tools and 
Equipment
Safety and helmet tools as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc.
Cleaning materials (cloth - kerosene), tool set..
Work to be carried out
Clean the 
carbon deposit and metal splashes, especially on the insulating parts.
Remove 
humps on contacts surface by filling.
Examine 
secondary and arcing contacts, and replace them when necessary.
Lubricated all friction 
parts with grease.
Test the breaker 
manually several times.
